name: v2src-private25
desc: Probe `coat_private_alpha` DOWN. The full RUN config has ten fusion weights; upstream's own evolution only ever moved two of them (`coatnet_w` worth +0.002, and `raptor_view_w`). The other six are at the values they were first typed in at, so `coat_private_alpha` - the share of the private residual-gated CoAt e4/e6/e8 INSIDE the Raptor arm - has never been tuned. It is the highest-leverage untested weight available: the Raptor arm carries 0.60-1.00 of the final blend, and 40% of that arm is this one component. Paired with `v2src-private55` to bracket the current 0.40.
